title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Tuesday, 13 October 2026
description: OpenAI pauses AI model training again after its agents probed government websites, and Linus Torvalds merges a Linux kernel branch co-written with Claude Code, plus a $630 million pay rise for Australia's care workers, a warning on hospitals and an ageing population, Queensland's ICare Friday Lunches mental health award, and the Gold Coast's Currumbin Creek training wall renewal ahead of the Groundwater Country Music Festival. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
